title: Progress continues to advance and the polite live-region continues to tick when the browser tab is backgrounded
asA: operator who tabs away from the upload while it is running
iWant: the upload to continue and the polite live-region to keep receiving ticks so a screen reader can pick up the announcement when I return
soThat: backgrounding the tab does not stall the upload or my accessibility affordance

acceptanceCriteria.description: On the ?background=1 branch of the fixture the fixture drives a visibilitychange event to hidden, the upload continues (the aggregate percent advances between two polite-tick reads separated by at least one polling interval), and the [data-live-region="polite"] wrapper's text updates. The pack reads the wrapper twice with a wait between and asserts the aggregate percent increased and the tick text changed.

The polite live region continues to tick under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; only the animated visual progress indicator switches to a static text ratio ("3 of 5 MiB"), the announcement cadence and shape are unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user agent asserting prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
acceptanceCriteria.then: the polite live region announcements continue at the same cadence and the visual indicator switches to static text
